text.name: Cox Report
text.rules: Record "designs copied". Draw from SAE's Contingency deck. If the result is 3 or more, SAE spends 2 points; otherwise, record "ring exposed", then LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: The US congressional Cox Report, released on 25 May 1999, alleged that China had obtained design information on US nuclear warheads through espionage over two decades.
